links.outcome: Change in clinical utility after classifier pipeline version update
links.effect: Updating bioinformatic pipeline from v11b4 to v12.8 rescued multiple ambiguous entries, raising overall clinical utility from 81.1% to 84.1%.
links.quote: Updating bioinformatic pipelines from version 11b4 to 12.8 rescued multiple ambiguous entries, increasing overall clinical utility to 84.1%.

links.outcome: Clinical usefulness of classifier output when integrated with histomorphology and ancillary markers
links.effect: 52.7% of lower-confidence cases yielded meaningful clinical integration when supported by histomorphology and ancillary markers; discrepant or misleading classifications occurred in 1.9%.
links.quote: Crucially, over half (52.7%) of the lower-confidence cases yielded meaningful clinical integration when supported by histomorphology and ancillary genetic or immunohistochemical markers, demonstrating that rigid score cutoffs should not dictate assay failure.

screen.reason: Evaluates real-world clinical deployment and integration practices (e.g., handling confidence score thresholds and updating bioinformatic pipelines) of a machine learning DNA methylation diagnostic classifier in CNS tumors.

primary.practice: multimodal clinicopathologic correlation with score threshold flexibility and pipeline updates
